notes: Figures were unavailable, so Figures 1-7 were judged from captions only. The literature check ran with the strict cutoff 2025-09-24 and 4 counted queries (one refused for 5 concept words, not counted); a search term for a 'theory' paper finds mostly off-topic arXiv results, so the baseline-scout step had no external benchmark to scout. Ambiguities in the skill: (1) the skill says the five reviewers must be independent, but a single model context made it impossible to keep a self-found theorem-level error (Assumption C.3) out of more than one report; I let R1 and the DA raise it and R2 hedge. (2) The skill asks the DA to re-check 'errors behind its CRITICAL issues' but does not say whether a non-experimental, theorem-level hypothesis inconsistency counts under criterion 1 (evidence contradicts claim) or 2 (experiment cannot test claim); I treated it as criterion 1. (3) The 'resolvable_without_new_data' field is named for data/experiments, whereas a theory fix needs new analysis; I set it to false so the cap is 3. (4) Phase 0 asks for a fingerprint file whose fields must be hand-edited, and shell variables are blocked in some hosts, so the commands had to use literal paths. (5) The Theorem 4.2 appendix (C.2) was only partially read for cost reasons; this is disclosed in review.md. (6) The pool-position rule 'Overall 4 requires pool >= 65' made it awkward to give the most positive reviewer a 4; I set R3 pool 65 to stay consistent. (7) The aggregation script returned eic_composite 54.5 in the BEFORE run (default weights, DA upheld) and 53.7 in the AFTER run, because the BEFORE input has no eic_weight; before_composite (54.8) is the raw official composite in both.
